meta.name: elevenlabs-stt
meta.description: ElevenLabs speech-to-text with Scribe models and forced alignment via inference.sh CLI. Models: Scribe v1/v2 (98%+ accuracy, 90+ languages). Capabilities: transcription, speaker diarization, audio event tagging, word-level timestamps, forced alignment, subtitle generation. Use for: meeting transcription, subtitles, podcast transcripts, lip-sync timing, karaoke. Triggers: elevenlabs stt, elevenlabs transcription, scribe, elevenlabs speech to text, forced alignment, word alignment, subtitle timing, diarization, speaker identification, audio event detection, eleven labs transcribe

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将语音转为文字，支持多语种和说话人识别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将音频或视频中的语音准确转成文字。
copy.tagline_en: Convert speech to text with high accuracy and speaker diarization
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to transcribe audio or video with speaker identification.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能转录音频为文字，支持说话人分离、音频事件标记、词级时间戳，还能通过已知文本对齐音频获得精确时间码。
howto.when: 当你提到“elevenlabs stt”、“转录”、“scribe”等关键词，或要求处理音频转文字、字幕生成、唇形同步时触发。

say.text: 帮我转录这段会议录音，并标出谁说了什么。
给这个播客音频生成带时间戳的字幕。
把这段旁白音频和文本对齐，输出逐字时间码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can transcribe audio to text with speaker diarization, audio event tagging, word-level timestamps, and forced alignment for precise timing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "elevenlabs stt", "transcription", "scribe", or request audio-to-text, subtitle generation, or lip-sync timing.

say_en.text: Transcribe this meeting recording and identify speakers.
Generate timed subtitles for this podcast audio.
Align this narration audio with the text and output word timings.
